title: DS Component Spec
description: The single component spec that drives BOTH legs of ds-component-author (the Figma component and the code twin). The anatomy and property axes are a human design decision (required input, never invented by the skill); the craft critique and the framework-idiom calls ship empty behind the named gates. classification: HeyHi Confidential.

name.description: PascalCase component name; becomes the Figma component-set name and the code component name.

level.description: Atomic level, aligned with ds-map.json (figma-library-census). A human design decision.

anatomy.description: The named regions of the component (a design decision, the human authors this; the skill never invents anatomy).

property_axes.description: The property model shared by both legs. VARIANT axes require a non-empty values array (a VARIANT with no values is rejected). A design decision.

values.description: The enum options for a VARIANT axis. Required and non-empty when type is VARIANT.

default.description: Default value (string for VARIANT/TEXT, boolean for BOOLEAN, component ref for INSTANCE_SWAP).

maps_to_prop.description: The code prop name this axis binds to (defaults to a camelCase of name).

states.description: Interaction states, taken from an interaction-inventory sidecar (heyhi:interaction-inventory:sidecar:1.0). State names use that schema's enum; a11y_hook carries the accessible name/role note per state.

applies_to.description: Which anatomy region the state applies to.

slots.description: Optional SLOT content regions (createSlot in Figma → children/getSlot in code). Empty when the component uses TEXT/INSTANCE_SWAP rather than a slot.

tokens.description: Role -> served-token-name map (semantic role tokens, not primitives, not literals). Retrieved through the design-system instance; the skill never reads a token file from disk.

framework.description: The code-leg target. v1 builds react; lit and angular are named stubs (D5).

emit.description: Emit the parserless .figma.ts template regardless of plan.

publish.description: Call add_code_connect_map. Requires an Organization/Enterprise plan AND an explicit plan allowance; false by default.

gate.description: The two named human gates. Both ship with null owner/date by construction; a human signs them. The skill never fills these.
